name: Open New Sub-Account
description: Looks up a member by ID and opens a new sub-account, reaching the confirmation screen.
discovery_goal: look up member {member_id}, open a new sub-account of type {account_type} with an initial deposit of {deposit}, and reach the confirmation screen

outputs.name: confirmation_number
outputs.description: Confirmation number for the opened sub-account

declared_outcomes.name: member_not_found
declared_outcomes.detect_text_contains: No record found for member ID
declared_outcomes.description: The searched member ID does not exist in the system.

declared_outcomes.name: validation_error
declared_outcomes.description: The sub-account form was submitted with missing/invalid fields (e.g. deposit below $25 minimum).

declared_outcomes.name: permission_denied
declared_outcomes.description: The operator lacks permission to open sub-accounts for this member's segment.

declared_outcomes.name: session_expired
declared_outcomes.description: The session expired mid-flow and requires re-authentication (out of scope for unattended retry).

steps.rationale: Start at the member search screen.

candidates.rationale: Form field 'name' attributes are far more stable than visual layout in legacy server-rendered apps; this app has no test IDs or labels to prefer instead.
Fallback: the only textbox on the search screen.

steps.rationale: Enter the member ID supplied by the caller.

candidates.rationale: input[type=submit] maps to accessible role 'button' with name from its value attribute; robust to markup/CSS changes.
Fallback: only submit control on this form.
Accessible role+visible text of the link; stable across styling changes.

steps.rationale: Navigate to the sub-account opening form for this member.

candidates.rationale: Form field name attribute; the select has no accessible label in this legacy markup.

steps.rationale: Choose the sub-account type supplied by the caller.
Enter the initial deposit amount supplied by the caller.

candidates.rationale: Accessible role+name of the submit control.

steps.rationale: This submits the sub-account opening — a real, effectively irreversible action in production (would require a reversal transaction, not a simple undo). Flagged irreversible so unattended replay requires pre-approval per policy.

candidates.rationale: Confirmation numbers are generated with a stable 'CNF-' prefix; matched via visible text.
Structural fallback: first data row, second column of the confirmation table.

steps.rationale: Capture the confirmation number to return to the calling agent.

candidates.rationale: The confirmation screen's heading is the definitive proof the flow completed.
